name: Byarum - Skillingaryd
description: Byarum to Skillingaryd. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official section title says Byarum - Skillingaryd, but GPX and official HÖ21/HÖ22 endpoint object place the actual trail endpoint at Grönelund, west of Skillingaryd. Skillingaryd station is reached by a separate unmarked connector.
Official connector is reported as 1.6 km in HTML/page text and 1.5 km in API according to agent reports.
Connector name says Byarum kyrka - HÖ20/HÖ22, but HÖ21 starts at Byarum and the connector is described from Byarum hembygdsgård to Byarum church/bus stop.

Official route text highlights Södra Duveled and one planning source references Södra Duveled Natura 2000, while WFS rules lane found the relevant near/on-route protected feature as Norra Duveled biotopskydd within about 2 m and did not find confident direct Natura 2000 overlap.
Official/facilities lanes report a water tap on the north side of Byarums hembygdsgård, but exact tap coordinate, public access and seasonality are not independently verified.
OSM relation 15427009 has good topology but endpoints are tens of meters from official GPX/ledentré positions and member total is 16.415 km versus official GPX about 16.325 km.

facilities.name: Byarum, ledentré HÖ20/HÖ21
facilities.description: Official shared HÖ20/HÖ21 trail entrance by Byarums hembygdsgård, with roadside parking, seasonal cafe and water-tap context. Deduplicate with HÖ20. Official page says parking for about eight cars and 24-hour limit. Water tap public access/seasonality and exact tap coordinate need verification before final potable-water import.

facilities.name: Byarums hembygdsgård
facilities.description: Hembygdsgård at the Byarum endpoint with summer cafe/serving and reported water tap on the north side of the main building. Opening dates/hours are time-sensitive; facilities lane found daily 10-19 summer context from mid-June to mid-August. Recheck before importing as active service or public potable water.

facilities.name: Grönelund, ledentré HÖ21/HÖ22
facilities.description: Official shared HÖ21/HÖ22 endpoint at Grönelunds friluftsområde with parking, shelter, fireplace/grill, outdoor gym, ball/cricket field, small playground, sledding hill, lappkåta, boule, parkour and open grass areas. Deduplicate with HÖ22. Treat detailed recreation facilities as endpoint context unless the app supports them as separate nearby amenities.

facilities.name: Grönelund vindskydd
facilities.description: Official shelter and fireplace/grill near the Grönelund endpoint, described as suitable for sleeping and grilling. Fire use is overridden by live fire-ban status. Exact relationship between shelter and endpoint cluster should be deduplicated with HÖ22.

facilities.name: Anslutning Byarum kyrka - HÖ20/HÖ22
facilities.description: Official access connector from Byarum hembygdsgård/ledentré to Byarum church and bus stop via Munkaleden. Connector name says HÖ20/HÖ22 although the immediate section endpoint topology is HÖ20/HÖ21. Inventory says 0.6 km; description says 640 m.

facilities.name: Anslutning Skillingaryd station - HÖ21/HÖ22
facilities.description: Official unmarked access connector from Skillingaryd station to the Grönelund/HÖ21-HÖ22 trailhead. Official section title says Skillingaryd, but the mainline endpoint is Grönelund. Connector length conflicts between 1.5 km API and 1.6 km page/text.
